corrections.criterion: Document CRLF normalization with an example
corrections.risk: False change reports for equivalent newlines

knowledge.content:
# Markdown diff

## Purpose
Compare two Markdown documents and report changed sections with line ranges.

## Behavior
Identical inputs return empty hunks. CRLF is normalized before comparison. Insertions and deletions preserve the old and new line coordinates. The implementation uses bounded processing for large inputs.

fragment.content: CRLF is normalized before comparison; identical documents return no changed sections.
